title: Truncation of a decision tree
statement: Given a binary decision tree, a fallback value, and a natural-number cutoff, truncation leaves terminal outputs unchanged. At cutoff $0$, each query is replaced by a leaf returning the fallback value; at a positive cutoff, the query is retained and both subtrees are truncated at one less than the cutoff.
hypotheses_covered: A fallback value in the output type
